نرتضي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَضِي (nartaḍī) /nar.ta.dˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# نَرْتَضِيَ (nartaḍiya) /nar.ta.dˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
